title: RADIANT: Object-Centric Feed-Forward Global Illumination
abstract: arXiv:2610.32075v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Feed-forward neural renderers synthesize global illumination across novel 3D scenes without per-scene optimization or runtime ray tracing. Existing transformer-based renderers tokenize individual triangles, so self-attention scales quadratically with mesh resolution. Yet macroscopic radiative transport is governed by the underlying surface geometry and object arrangements rather than a particular mesh discretization; finer tessellation can thus inflate token counts without changing the underlying transport physics, motivating a discretization-agnostic and object-centric representation. We introduce RADIANT (RADiance-based Inter-Actor Neural Transformer), an object-centric architecture for feed-forward global illumination from point inputs. translated_title: RADIANT：以物体为中心的前馈全局光照
translated_abstract: 前馈神经渲染器能够在全新3D场景中合成全局光照，无需逐场景优化或运行时光线追踪。现有基于Transformer的渲染器以单个三角形为单位进行token化，因此自注意力的计算开销随网格分辨率呈二次方增长。然而，宏观的辐射传输本质上由底层表面几何与物体空间排列决定，而非特定的网格离散化方式；因此更精细的网格剖分只会在不改变底层传输物理的前提下增加token数量。这促使我们采用一种与离散化无关的、以物体为中心的表示方法。我们提出RADIANT（RADiance-based Inter-Actor Neural Transformer，基于辐射的交互体神经Transformer），这是一种从点输入进行前馈全局光照的以物体为中心的架构。通过用紧凑的32个表面补丁token表示每个物体，RADIANT将注意力序列长度与多边形数量解耦。在单一网络中，物体间场景Transformer……
tldr: 提出RADIANT架构，以物体为中心、每个物体仅用32个表面补丁token表示，将注意力序列长度与多边形数量解耦，从而在无需逐场景优化或运行时光线追踪的情况下高效合成新3D场景的全局光照。
en_tdlr: RADIANT introduces an object-centric feed-forward neural architecture that represents each object with just 32 surface-patch tokens, decoupling attention sequence length from mesh resolution to efficiently synthesize global illumination in novel 3D scenes without per-scene optimization or runtime ray tracing.
